full_prompt_en: A square landscape painting shows a broad white road curving from the lower-left foreground toward a distant, nearly level horizon. The road bends in an exaggerated S shape between ocher fields and blocklike forms, acting as the strongest visual path through the composition. At the left, a cluster of tall bare trunks supports a compact canopy of faceted cream, tan, and muted yellow shapes. Nearby, angular walls or stone structures rise from the ground in warm brown and pale gray planes. A small rounded green form sits at their base. In the middle distance, fields are divided into sloping bands of ocher, olive, gray, and light blue; some are striped with narrow dark lines. Small round trees and low rectilinear forms punctuate the open terrain. Beyond them, a thin pale plain meets the blue sky. A circular, pale moonlike disc floats above the horizon near the upper-left center, while barely visible triangular hill shapes recede into the atmospheric distance. The picture has no single dramatic spotlight. Cool, clear daylight evenly reveals the geometric surfaces, casting only restrained shifts from light to dark. The sky is brushed in textured blue arcs and fades toward a lighter band at the horizon. Ground forms carry dry, directional marks, while edges remain strongly simplified into clean planes. Although the road implies a route into depth, the angular blocks and repeated stripes hold the scene near the picture surface. The result is quiet and slightly dreamlike: familiar countryside reorganized into flattened curves, faceted volumes, and a cool airy distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风景画描绘一条宽阔白路，从左下前景弯向远处几乎水平的地平线。道路在赭色田地和方块状形体间形成夸张的S形，是贯穿构图最强的视觉路径。左侧一簇高而裸露的树干托着紧凑树冠，由多面体般的奶油、棕褐和低饱和黄色形状组成。旁边，棱角分明的墙体或石构件从地上升起，显出暖棕与浅灰色平面。其脚下有一枚小小的圆形绿色体。中景田地被分割为倾斜的赭、橄榄、灰和淡蓝色带；其中一些带有细窄深色条纹。小圆树和低矮矩形结构点在开阔地形中。再远处，一片浅色平原与蓝天相接。一枚浅色月亮般的圆盘浮在偏左上方的地平线上，几乎看不清的三角山形退向空气中的远方。画面没有单一戏剧性聚光。清凉明亮的日光均匀揭示几何表面，仅带来克制的明暗变化。天空以带纹理的蓝色弧形笔触绘成，向地平线处渐淡。地面形体上留有干涩的方向性笔痕，边缘则被强烈简化为干净平面。道路虽暗示通向纵深，棱角形块和重复条纹仍使场景贴近画面表层。结果安静而略有梦意：熟悉乡野被重新整理为扁平曲线、多面体体量和清凉通透的距离。
style_prompt_en: Modernist landscape painting reduces observed space to faceted blocks, broad arcs, and bands of flattened color. A bright serpentine line can lead through the frame while repeated stripes and compact round accents hold the design together. Warm ocher and tan planes meet cool blue, pale gray, olive, and cream. Dry directional brush marks remain visible within large simplified forms; edges are firm, but atmospheric distance softens toward a light horizon. Clear, even daylight creates gentle plane-to-plane contrast rather than dramatic shadow. The overall rhythm is ordered and dreamlike, balancing strong surface geometry with a convincing path into depth.
style_prompt_zh: 现代主义风景绘画把观察到的空间化为多面体色块、宽弧线和扁平色带。明亮的蛇形线可以引导视线穿过画面，重复条纹和紧凑圆形重音则让设计保持整体。暖赭与棕褐色面同冷蓝、浅灰、橄榄绿和奶油色相接。干涩的方向性笔痕仍可在大块简化形体内看见；边缘坚实，空气中的远景向浅色地平线柔化。清晰均匀的日光制造平面之间温和反差，而非戏剧阴影。整体节奏有序而如梦，在强烈表层几何感与可信的纵深路径间求得平衡。
theme_en: A winding pale road through a geometric landscape beneath a blue sky
theme_zh: 浅色弯路穿过蓝天下的几何化风景
name: Paul Nash
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
